rationale: C12 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both are Eisenhower letters to a Cabinet secretary establishing a new interdepartmental or Cabinet committee, naming the addressee as chairman, specifying core departmental membership, providing for participation by additional agencies, and assigning a coordination function. The close wording and parallel operative sequence are materially stronger than a merely shared governmental topic. C14 and C16 use closely related committee-establishment formulas, but their provisions for broader agency participation and intergovernmental coordination are less closely aligned with the child.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As you have suggested, I am establishing an Interdepartmental Committee on Migratory Labor
shared_material.parent_excerpt: To meet the needs to which I have referred above, I am establishing a Cabinet Committee on Water Resources Policy.
shared_material.explanation: Both move from a statement of the policy problem directly to presidential establishment of a named coordinating committee.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am designating you as Chairman.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am designating you the Chairman of the Cabinet Committee on Water Resources Policy.
shared_material.explanation: This is nearly identical operative language assigning the addressee the chairmanship.

shared_material.child_excerpt: made up of the Secretaries of the Interior, Agriculture, Labor, and Health, Education, and Welfare and the Administrator of the Housing and Home Finance Agency
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary of Defense and the Secretary of Agriculture will serve with you on the committee as full members
shared_material.explanation: Each letter follows establishment and chair designation with an enumeration of senior executive-branch members.

shared_material.child_excerpt: there are other departments and agencies which have major interests in specific areas, and I shall expect you, as Chairman, to keep them informed and to invite their participation as needed
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary of Commerce, the Secretary of Health, Education and Welfare and the Director of the Bureau of the Budget will participate on an ad hoc basis.
shared_material.explanation: Both provide machinery for participation by agencies beyond the committee's core membership.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This Committee will aid the various Federal agencies in mobilizing and stimulating more effective programs and services
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Inter-Agency Committee on Water Resources will provide a facility for improving the coordination of existing policies, programs and activities of the participating Departments and Agencies
shared_material.explanation: Both assign the committee a substantive role in coordinating and improving existing agency programs rather than creating a new operating bureaucracy.
